def VTask.evenOddRec {P : ℕ → Sort u_1} (h0 : P 0) (h_even : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n)) (h_odd : (n : ℕ) → P n → P (2 * n + 1)) (n : ℕ) : P n := by
  have h_main : ∀ n, P n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 => exact h0
      | n + 1 =>
        -- We need to consider the cases where n + 1 is even or odd.
        have h₁ : n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2) ∨ n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2) + 1 := by
          have h₂ : n % 2 = 0 ∨ n % 2 = 1 := by omega
          rcases h₂ with (h₂ | h₂)
          · -- Case: n % 2 = 0
            have h₃ : n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2) + 1 := by
              omega
            exact Or.inr h₃
          · -- Case: n % 2 = 1
            have h₃ : n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2) + 1 := by
              omega
            exact Or.inr h₃
        rcases h₁ with (h₁ | h₁)
        · -- Case: n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2)
          have h₂ : P (n + 1) := by
            have h₃ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := by
              apply ih (n / 2)
              have h₄ : n / 2 < n + 1 := by
                have h₅ : n / 2 < n + 1 := by
                  omega
                exact h₅
              omega
            have h₄ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₃
            have h₅ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₄
            have h₆ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₅
            have h₇ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₆
            have h₈ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₇
            -- Use the even step to get P (2 * (n / 2)) from P (n / 2)
            have h₉ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h_even (n / 2) (ih (n / 2) (by
              have h₁₀ : n / 2 < n + 1 := by
                have h₁₁ : n / 2 < n + 1 := by
                  omega
                exact h₁₁
              omega
            ))
            simp_all [h₁]
            <;> aesop
          exact h₂
        · -- Case: n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2) + 1
          have h₂ : P (n + 1) := by
            have h₃ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := by
              have h₄ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := by
                apply ih (n / 2)
                have h₅ : n / 2 < n + 1 := by
                  have h₆ : n / 2 < n + 1 := by
                    omega
                  exact h₆
                omega
              have h₅ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₄
              have h₆ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := by
                have h₇ : P (2 * (n / 2)) := h₅
                have h₈ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := by
                  apply h_odd (n / 2) h₇
                exact h₈
              exact h₆
            have h₅ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := h₃
            have h₆ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := h₅
            have h₇ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := h₆
            have h₈ : P (2 * (n / 2) + 1) := h₇
            simp_all [h₁]
            <;> aesop
          exact h₂
  exact h_main n
